direction: Spatial-relatedness (Shaw-style) ruin scoring with load-imbalance gating and stagnation-adaptive rank power to target the weakest regimes (clustered spatial, loose capacity, size=100, eccentric depot)

operations.mechanism: KB method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 confirms the L3 skeleton (unified deadline, CW + intra_2opt, deterministic Regret-2 repair, R2R acceptance) returns feasible solutions in ~2-3ms and leaves all remaining budget to the LNS loop; with 2000ms budget and current mean solve of 155ms there is large unused slack, so the binding constraint is destroy-quality, not time. KB method-cvrp-lns-shaw-regret identifies Shaw relatedness (spatial+distance coherence) as the standard complement to worst-cost removal, and archive weak-regime profile (clustered, loose capacity, size=100, eccentric depot) indicates the current savings-only ranking destroys scattered singletons instead of whole geographic clusters. The evolvable hook keeps one entry point score_ruin_nodes returning a finite length-n float vector, read-only state, deterministic tie-breaking, and adds stagnation-adaptive rank power (KB pitfall: 25ms exhaustion not relevant at 2000ms). Postprocess stays 'none' since allowed modes are restricted and the skeleton already applies intra_2opt + R2R.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: H-r4-01: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 under the 2000ms budget (mean solve only ~155ms, so the LNS loop gets many hundreds of iterations with slack), replacing a purely cost-savings-based score_ruin_nodes with a multiplicative rule score_i = rank_power( normalized( |removal_savings_i| ) * (1 + beta * cluster_pressure_i) * gate_load_i * gate_depot_i , p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio) ) where cluster_pressure_i = mean distance from node i to its k nearest neighbours relative to the instance-mean nearest-neighbour distance (small => node sits in a dense cluster whose removal unlocks re-partitioning), gate_load_i = route_loads[r]/capacity sharpening when capacity is loose, and p rises from ~1.2 to ~4.0 with stagnation_ratio, will lower mean tour length below the current SBS 16.0293 on the clustered / loose-capacity / size-100 slices without degrading the AFV (all 24 instances remain feasible, first_feasible_ms stays < 10ms). Rationale: VBS gaps are largest on clustered (-19.30%), loose-capacity (-22.30%) and size-100 (-21.11%) slices, i.e., exactly where contiguous-cluster destroy (rather than single-route worst-cost destroy) is needed; a higher rank power under stagnation prevents the deterministic Regret-2 repair from cycling the same nodes.
